Virtual Participation: https://sandiego.gov/councilmtg
To join by telephone: Dial 1-669 254 5252 + input Webinar ID: 160 943 0466
_________________
NOTE : In accordance with the San Diego City Council Permanent Rules for Noticing and Conduct of Closed Session Meetings, adopted by Resolution No. R-310153 on December 8, 2015, a portion of the regular open meeting agenda of the City Council has been reserved for City Attorney comment, public comment, and City Council discussion of the content of this Closed Session Agenda. Public testimony for this Closed Session Agenda will be taken today during the 10:00 a.m. Council meeting. Court records about existing litigation are available to the public on the San Diego Superior Court’s Website http://www.sdcourt.ca.gov and Register of Actions http://odyroa.sdcourt.ca.gov .

SDCA Assigned: M. T. Phelps
SDCA Assigned: S. M. Robinson
Outside Counsel:
D. Semerdjian and J. Schena, Schwartz Semerdjian Cauley Schena & Bush;
M. Dean and S. Gazzo, Dean Gazzo Roistacher;
J. Morris and W. Pate, Devaney Pate Morris;
C. Miller and R. Caplan, Buchalter, APC
This matter involves numerous lawsuits arising from an extreme rainstorm that occurred on January 22, 2024, which resulted in flooding throughout the City. The inverse condemnation lawsuits allege the Plaintiffs suffered real and personal property damage due to the flooding. The City Attorney’s Office will update the Mayor and City Council on the status of the lawsuits and seek direction.
Consultation with City of San Diego’s Chief Information Security Officer, pursuant to California Government Code Section 54957(a):
CS-2 Critical Infrastructure Information Relating to Cybersecurity
Risk Management Department Claim File No. N/A
SDCA Assigned: S. R. Lastomirsky
The Department of Information Technology’s Chief Information Security Officer,
Chief Information Officer, Cyber Security Manager, Enterprise Applications Manager, and Assistant Deputy Director and the City’s CFO will present a confidential report to
City Council on critical infrastructure information relating to cybersecurity, including
high-risk legacy applications that should be prioritized for replacement based on risk assessments. The confidential report will provide visibility of budget priorities for legacy applications and information on risks impacting technology, business operations, and cyber security.
